tour.title: Guided tour
tour.tourHintBody: New to FayaNMS? Walk the platform once — dashboard, devices, configs, changes and operations.
tour.step1Body: Every operations morning starts here: device health, critical alerts and backup compliance across HQ and the branch sites.
tour.step2Body: Search and slice the managed estate — then save a filter set as a reusable view for the next shift.
tour.step3Body: Scheduled policies capture every config version; the history and retention rules live in this module.
tour.step4Body: When a running config drifts from its approved baseline, the diff lands here for triage.
tour.step5Body: Risk-scored change requests, approvals and a step-by-step execution timeline with auto-rollback.
tour.step6Body: Threshold rules deduplicate and suppress; acknowledge, assign or escalate straight from the stream.
tour.step7Body: The audit timeline ties each action to a correlation id — perfect for post-incident review.
tour.step8Body: Availability and latency trends from rollup data — spot degradation before users call.
tour.step9Body: Roles and permissions, the credential vault, API clients and the audit chain live under Administration.
